Here are the steps of the Euclidean algorithm:

Here are the steps of the Euclidean algorithm:

1. Divide 1407 by 903 and find the remainder.
   \[
   1407 \div 903 = 1 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 1407 - 903 \times 1 = 504
   \]
   So, \(1407 = 903 \times 1 + 504\).

2. Now, take 903 and 504, and divide 903 by 504.
   \[
   903 \div 504 = 1 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 903 - 504 \times 1 = 415
   \]
   So, \(903 = 504 \times 1 + 415\).

3. Next, take 504 and 415, and divide 504 by 415.
   \[
   504 \div 415 = 1 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 504 - 415 \times 1 = 89
   \]
   So, \(504 = 415 \times 1 + 89\).

4. Now, take 415 and 89, and divide 415 by 89.
   \[
   415 \div 89 = 4 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 415 - 89 \times 4 = 19
   \]
   So, \(415 = 89 \times 4 + 19\).

5. Next, take 89 and 19, and divide 89 by 19.
   \[
   89 \div 19 = 4 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 89 - 19 \times 4 = 11
   \]
   So, \(89 = 19 \times 4 + 11\).

6. Now, take 19 and 11, and divide 19 by 11.
   \[
   19 \div 11 = 1 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 19 - 11 \times 1 = 8
   \]
   So, \(19 = 11 \times 1 + 8\).

7. Next, take 11 and 8, and divide 11 by 8.
   \[
   11 \div 8 = 1 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 11 - 8 \times 1 = 3
   \]
   So, \(11 = 8 \times 1 + 3\).

8. Now, take 8 and 3, and divide 8 by 3.

   \]

9. Finally, take 3 and 2, and divide 3 by 2.
   \[
   3 \div 2 = 1 \quad \text{with a remainder of} \quad 3 - 2 \times 1 = 1
   \]

    \[
